class.name: SteamAudioSceneTools
class.brief_description: Scene inspection helpers shared by the editor plugin and usable from tool scripts.
class.description: Backs the [b]Project > Tools > Steam Audio[/b] menu. The same methods are callable from [code]@tool[/code] scripts so you can script acoustic setup or check a scene in CI.

method.name: find_geometry_targets
method.description: Every [MeshInstance3D] and [CollisionShape3D] below [param root] that has no acoustic geometry child yet.

method.name: validate_scene
method.description: One line per problem found in the scene below [param root]. An empty array means the setup looks usable.
